invalidation_reasons.detail: Contract-invalid B responses were physically cached for C, but the failure cache did not preserve raw response identity in the C record. The reported replay_identity_rate therefore did not measure the intended invariant for malformed responses.
Unparseable dataset responses were incorrectly counted as target-scope valid because dataset_reasoner_failed was not treated as non-evaluable.
When a later D field group failed, successful earlier group records and failed fallback-attempt records were not retained in the VariantRun, undercounting per-call token/context provenance.

backend_environment_failures.detail: The HDF5 dataset-level request contained 10044 prompt tokens and was rejected before generation because the loaded context was 8192.
Most responses spent the generation budget on reasoning. A one-call diagnostic that supplied both reasoning=off and enable_thinking=false still reported 2995 reasoning tokens.

required_before_rerun: Use an LM Studio runtime in which Qwen3.6 reasoning-off is demonstrably honored; LM Studio 0.4.18 or newer is the minimum version implicated by the upstream fix record.
Reload the exact model with at least a 16384-token runtime context and record the exact loaded configuration.
Record the LM Studio runtime version and checkpoint-file SHA-256.
Rerun the unchanged eight-case manifest after the replay, scope-evaluability, context-accounting, and partial-D provenance fixes pass tests.
